Properties.AlarmDescription: Agent machines had 200 or more website lookups blocked by the DNS firewall in 5 minutes. Check the DNS firewall log /agentx/staging/dns-firewall for the blocked names and the source addresses, and check which workspaces were running. A tool that needs a site not on the allowlist is the usual cause; add it with the agentxEgressAllowDomains context if it is legitimate.

More than 20 GiB left through the NAT gateway in use1-az1 in an hour. Check which workspaces were running then, and check the DNS firewall log /agentx/staging/dns-firewall for what they looked up. The firewall does not stop a connection made straight to an IP address, so a large transfer may not show in the log.

More than 20 GiB left through the NAT gateway in use1-az2 in an hour. Check which workspaces were running then, and check the DNS firewall log /agentx/staging/dns-firewall for what they looked up. The firewall does not stop a connection made straight to an IP address, so a large transfer may not show in the log.
